verdict.rationale: Ramp's own customer story says AIRCO achieved "Full onboarding in 1 week vs. 6 months on prior platform". Ramp also documents a banking product (Checking and Investment Accounts) and an application flow where the applicant finishes sign-up in the Ramp UI. The one-week claim, however, is a single vendor testimonial that is not tied specifically to banking onboarding, and no onboarding process or timeline is documented. Missing for 10: documented banking onboarding steps and typical timeline, evidence the one-week figure applies to the banking product, independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.
